contract.parameter_status: ASS_OFFICIAL_DEFAULT_METHOD_PARAMETER; transcription verification never becomes measured Hungarian OBS
contract.source_fidelity: E1_SOURCE_FIDELITY_ONLY; no E1/E2 programme applicability admission
contract.lineage: Original panel and qualification bytes pinned separately; stable semantic record_id plus original ordinal and metadata digest
contract.source_identity: No inferred alias, dropped OFFICIAL suffix, failed acquisition or superseded document substitution
contract.energy_boundary: NCV fuel input; no GCV, useful-heat, electricity or gas-volume substitution
contract.uncertainty: Retain native bounds; no distribution, correlation, independent scenario grid or national interval selected
contract.pm_boundary: Unclear, filterable-only and total-primary-plus-condensable remain distinct; no ambient exposure or health inference
contract.carbon_boundary: Individual pollutant mass; biogenic CO2 physical combustion retained separately; no GWP or carbon-neutrality claim
contract.abatement: Source NA is not installed-device status; numerical adjustment remains unselected
contract.hu_context: NID gas factors retain activity-year and power-plant versus residential scope; no exact 2025 residential coefficient admitted. IIR device shares need denominator/year/energy reconciliation before weighting
contract.electricity_context: EEA gross-generation GHG average and AIB production/residual/supplier CO2 accounting averages remain distinct; no physical marginal or import response admitted
contract.refrigerant_context: Broad inventory assumptions are not device-specific heat-pump leakage; unresolved leakage remains unknown, never zero
contract.population: A defensible representative/calibrated inference may bridge national activity and device weights; full household microdata are not mandatory
contract.implementation: Strict read-only consumer; no file materializer, conversion, selected default, weights, emissions, health or monetisation arithmetic
